tasks.title: Browse and filter effective and shadowed checks, inspect history and export redacted definitions
tasks.spec: ## Repository: console, read/list/detail/shadowed/export behavior and corresponding Checks; R1-R3, R7, R9 for these routes; Decisions 1, 4-5, 11-12; Counterexamples (Display percent, Budget sign, Filters, Roles for reads/exports); Rollout order. Pin merged contract main; extend the fake API compatibly to record method/query/headers/body and select replies by method/path, with literal six-type/source/state fixtures. Implement bounded parallel validated reads and panel-specific failures/older-API handling, query validation/encoding, list/filter/count/empty/file-health states, settings and historical detail with no runtime attribution to shadowed definitions, and all/single/shadowed redacted export. Add the download PageResult, secure GET/HEAD response support, route registration, navigation and fixed metric labels. Extend the one script for selectable heartbeat text/copy buttons. Activate create/edit/delete links with their handlers in T3. Update read/export documentation with this step; T4 completes release documentation.

tasks.title: Parse and render all six editor types with explicit write-only value intents
tasks.spec: ## Repository: console, check-form/check-editor-page behavior and parser Checks; R4 field/default/validation bullets and R5 form/intent bullets; Decisions 6-7 and 12; Counterexamples (Form size body fixture, Field rules, Write-only intents, Header name). Use the fixed stored id/type in edit rendering/parsing and contract validation; register the flows in T3. Never redisplay submitted literal header values, body or secret after any failure. tasks.title: Create, edit and delete checks with revision checks, current authorization and People-log outcomes

Register create/edit/delete using T2 forms, activate the R1/R2 role-specific actions, add route-specific form bounds without changing dispatcher order, and use requestJson with no retry. Re-read source/revision after validation, retain the shown edit/delete revision and use the latest read revision for create. Recheck the live session and stored user role immediately after the awaited read and before outbound mutation, using the existing credential-guard/store patterns and roleOf override. Include the small account-store bridge/tests needed to append People events: current server dependencies expose stores, not a raw database. Log confirmed/unknown remote outcomes, handle a failed local event insert after remote success, map every R8 result safely and scrub write-only input on all failure/replay paths.
